Usage: memoriahub organize [options] [folder...]

Move files into YEAR/MM - Month/ folders by EXIF capture date (undated →
NODATE/)

Arguments:
  folder             Paths to folders to organize (omit to use --all)

Options:
  --all              Organize all registered enabled folders (default: false)
  --dry-run          Preview the moves without touching any files (default:
                     false)
  -r, --recursive    Descend into sub-directories (when auto-registering a
                     folder) (default: false)
  --concurrency <n>  Number of concurrent workers
  --json             Emit the summary as JSON instead of a table (default:
                     false)
  -h, --help         display help for command
